results.text: Effects of pramlintide in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: an analysis using daily insulin dose tertiles. The purpose of the analysis was to investigate if the efficacy and tolerability of 6 months of pramlintide therapy in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) differed with increasing levels of concomitant insulin doses, using data from 3 previously described clinical trials.

results.text: Population Pharmacokinetics of Trofinetide in a Pediatric Population Aged 2-4 Years with Rett Syndrome.
